content:
🌍💃 The world dances in Odessa!

Join us at the International Cultural Festival for Turkish Zeybek & Kids’ Erik Dalı, Tajik Children’s Dance, Kyrgyzstan’s Kochmondor Dance, and performances representing Mexico, China, India, the Philippines, Ecuador, Nigeria, Gambia, Iraq, and Jordan—plus a special Navajo Nation blessing ceremony!

📅 Saturday, October 24, 2026
🕓 4:00–7:00 PM
📍 Odessa College Downtown Greenspace

🎤 Want to represent your country through dance or song? Please message us to join!

Bring your family and celebrate cultures from around the world! 🎉
Odessa Hispanic Chamber

content:
At the kind invitation of Pastor Jake Sanchez, our Peace Academy of West Texas community enjoyed a wonderful Sunday with Presence Church  in Midland.

We were warmly welcomed as guests at their service and respectfully listened to their prayers and Pastor Jake’s message. Afterward, we shared friendly conversations and made new friends. Seeing our young people connect was especially meaningful.

As Muslims and Christians, we cherish our own faith traditions while building friendships through kindness, listening, and mutual respect.

Thank you, Pastor Jake and the Presence Church family, for your warm welcome and generous hospitality. We look forward to growing these friendships!

content:
Today, Peace Academy of West Texas volunteers joined the Chinese community’s Mid-Autumn Festival celebration at @midcitieschurch  in Midland. It was a lovely day of sharing food, traditions, and conversation—and a chance for our communities to get to know one another better. 🏮

We were happy to welcome @applerouserouse  and friends to one of our gatherings recently, and we’re grateful to Apple for inviting our volunteers today. We’re also excited that the Chinese community plans to take a bigger part in this year’s International Cultural Festival!

Thank you to everyone who made our volunteers feel so welcome. We look forward to more moments together. ❤️
